items.desc_now: Investment workflows for AI agents: evidence, opposing cases, and outcomes checked by Python.
items.desc_prev: AI argues. Code settles. The losses stay on the page. A real HK + US brokerage account run by agents that must debate every call, settled by code the model never touches. Strategies are plugins whose parameter searches can only propose. Install the same workflow into OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, or DeepSeek Harness.

items.desc_now: Through Jev or through its own tool calls, the agent switches model presets and thinking depth on its own, following the task at hand. A DeepSeek Harness plugin: set_model/list_models tools, preset-only switching, Plan Mode staging and a Web settings page.
items.desc_prev: Model policy for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): free mode set_model/list_models, preset mode switch_preset/list_presets, configurable stage-to-model policy prompt, plan-mode staging, and a bundled Web settings page.
